name: ig_fact_final
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/ig_fact_final; mkdir -p $O
python3 ../map_ground_hq.py foundry_row --px 64 --samples 32 --out $O/ground_foundry_row.png --watersrc $O/water_src_foundry_row.png > $O/ground.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/ground.log; exit 1)
ls -la $O
